rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the common house sparrow.

example.english: That sparrow comes to the windowsill looking for food every morning.
example.traditional: 窗台嗰隻麻雀日日朝早都嚟搵食。
example.jyutping: coeng1 toi1 go2 zek3 maa4 zoek2 jat6 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 lai4 wan2 sik6

rows.note: Use this only when discussing the taxonomic family Passeridae rather than an individual common sparrow.

example.english: The sparrow family includes house sparrows, tree sparrows, and other small songbirds.
example.traditional: 雀科鳥類包括麻雀、樹麻雀及其他細小鳴禽。
example.jyutping: zoek3 fo1 niu5 leoi6 baau1 kut3 maa4 zoek3 syu6 maa4 zoek2 kap6 kei4 taa1 sai3 siu2 ming4 kam4
